lesson.title: Mealtime greetings and household labels
lesson.register_note: Both greetings are taught in the form the cited dictionary entries label polite: いただきます is the ます form, and ごちそうさまでした is labelled Polite (teineigo). Informal family variants are not taught in this fixture.

targets.meaning: thank you (for the meal just served); I receive (this meal)
thank you for the meal; that was a delicious meal

tasks.title: Say the before-meal greeting at one meal
tasks.context: At your own table, just before you start eating a meal today.
steps: Before you start eating, say いただきます (itadakimasu) out loud.
Say it at one meal today: breakfast, lunch or dinner.
Tick the meal at the foot of this page.
tasks.success_criterion: You said いただきます once, out loud, at the table, before eating one meal.

tasks.title: Say the after-meal greeting when you finish
tasks.context: At your own table, when you have finished eating a meal today.
steps: When you finish eating, say ごちそうさまでした (gochisōsamadeshita) out loud.
Say it at one meal today: breakfast, lunch or dinner.
Tick the meal at the foot of this page.
tasks.success_criterion: You said ごちそうさまでした once, out loud, at the table, after finishing one meal.

tasks.title: Label three household objects
tasks.context: At home, on three objects you pass every day.
steps: Write one lesson word on a small label and stick it on the object.
Do this for three objects from the lesson list.
When you pass a label for the next two days, say the word aloud.
tasks.success_criterion: Three objects carry the lesson's word, and you said each word aloud when you passed it on two days.

target_sets.title: Household labels from this lesson
target_sets.note: The learner chooses any three of the six lesson labels; the three printed on the sheet are a suggestion.

notes: Each task names one target object, one place-and-time context and one observable success criterion.
No task asks for a photo, location, recording or proof of completion.
No task produces a grade, score, XP or mastery claim; completion is self-reported.
